title: Certificate User Award in the Summit Program
content:
A Crestline Summit Loyalty Program member who has used Summit Upgrade Certificates recently receives a certificate-user award on a choice-benefit certificate issue. It follows the certificate redemption entries posted on the membership in the last twelve months, each redemption entry counting once:

| Certificate redemption entries in the last twelve months | Certificates added |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 |
| Exactly 1 | 1 |
| None | None |

An entry counts when its posting date is fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the day of the issue. The award is a whole number of certificates added to the issue.

**Hypothetical reading.** A member with one certificate redemption entry posted eight months ago and another posted thirteen months ago has one entry in the span and receives 1 certificate.
